items.title: Using Threat Intelligence to Track and Disrupt Ransomware Attacks
items.summary: Ransomware does not start when files are encrypted. By then, an attacker may already have obtained valid credentials, entered the network, moved between systems and established a command-and-control (C2) channel. That gives defenders an earlier window to act.
